name: monday.com MCP
description: Lets AI agents read and update monday.com boards, items, columns, updates, and forms through a hosted OAuth MCP server or local npm package, with optional GraphQL API access.

skills.name: Item Operations
skills.description: Creates, searches, and deletes items, changes column values, moves items between groups, and posts updates on items.

skills.name: Board Operations
skills.description: Creates boards, groups, and columns, removes columns, and reads a board's schema of columns and groups before edits.

skills.name: Dynamic GraphQL Tools
skills.description: Fetches the monday.com GraphQL schema and runs any generated query or mutation via all_monday_api (beta, opt-in).

skills.name: WorkForms Management
skills.description: Creates monday.com forms and retrieves existing forms by token so agents can set up intake flows for boards.
